entities.name: PMID:25075066
observations: 2014 case report: a heavily pre-treated breast cancer patient with extensive liver infiltration developed life-threatening liver-test deterioration despite paclitaxel, capecitabine, vinorelbine, and carboplatin/gemcitabine.
After compassionate-use Legasil, a nutraceutical containing a silibinin formulation, the patient had clinical and liver improvement and could continue palliative chemotherapy.
The report describes a clinical benefit but is a single uncontrolled case, so it cannot establish that silibinin alone caused the improvement.
